description: List the apps a rental can start with, installed and running and opened in the browser by its own link: today ComfyUI (node-based image and video generation: Flux, SDXL, Wan). Each has a slug for create_rental's template, the version a rental gets (tested and pinned), and what a machine needs (min_vram_gb per GPU, min_disk_gb). Pick a node whose templates in list_gpus contains the slug. Read-only, no cost. Use it when the user wants to generate images or video, or names one of these apps.
name: list_templates
